root_cause: R9L test encoded generation-time absence of a v6 owner-review file as a permanent repository invariant; the later valid v6 review record made that assertion stale.

historical_state.meaning: At PDF-v6 generation, owner review and execution authority were absent.

current_state.meaning: A later separately committed owner decision exists and grants only its exact recorded scope.

pytest_resolution.mechanism: strict expected-failure marker applied by forward tests/conftest.py collection policy to the single stale node ID
pytest_resolution.reason: preserve the hash-bound historical test while making its superseded temporal assertion explicit

forward_assertions: R9L generation manifest still records no authority at generation time
R9L historical test hash remains unchanged
v6 owner-review record is separate and postdates the generation artifact
current authority is limited to the exact later review record
no old review overrides current state and no current review rewrites history
